note: Reference images are the property of ARTS&SCIENCE; stored locally for treatment analysis only, never republished.
source: online-intl.arts-science.com homepage hero mosaic (6 product shots, 3024w)

backdrop.description: Bright neutral light-grey sweep, just off white. Perfectly neutral (no cast). Very even, with only a whisper of natural falloff/shadow retained around the product — not a flat digital fill.

treatment.color: Natural saturation per product, no global desaturation or stylistic grade.
treatment.contrast: Natural full-range contrast. Blacks reach ~10 (not lifted), highlights ~213 (not clipped). No S-curve grade, no faded blacks.
treatment.exposure: Backdrop keyed to ~236; subject exposure natural, matched across the set.
treatment.framing: 3:4 portrait, product centered with generous headroom, high-res source (3024px) served scaled.
treatment.vignette: None applied; slight natural falloff only.
treatment.white_balance: Neutral grey-world on backdrop; cast deviation ~0 across all samples.

shopify.note: All iswas demo work will eventually move to Shopify (Dawn 15.3.0).
shopify.format: sRGB JPEG q85-90; PNG only for transparency
shopify.cdn: Shopify CDN auto-serves WebP/AVIF + responsive widths from image_url; upload one high-quality master
shopify.theme_code: serve via | image_url / | image_tag with widths, never hotlink demo paths; alt text on every product image
shopify.framing: keep consistent aspect ratios (e.g. 3:4) so Dawn image_ratio crops stay predictable
